title: FleetRegistry
description: Local repos the fleet verbs (bin/fleet.sh registry CRUD, bin/fleet-doctor.sh bulk audit, bin/fleet-retrofit.sh bulk remediation planning) operate on. Stored at ~/.claude/nyann/fleet.json. Distinct from the sentinel watch-list (GitHub slugs for remote CI polling): fleet entries are LOCAL working-copy paths for governance verbs, and the optional `repo` slug is the join key between the two lists. Pure data — nothing in an entry is ever executed.

path.description: Absolute path to a local git working copy (the repo toplevel).

name.description: Display name, unique across the registry. Defaults to basename(path) at add time; hand-edited files may omit it (readers fall back to the basename).

repo.description: Optional GitHub slug in <owner>/<repo> form — the join key to the sentinel watch-list (--watch mirroring).

profile.description: Optional profile pin. Overrides the repo's own profile hint during fleet runs. Accepts a bare starter/user name or a namespaced team/name.

tags.description: Optional grouping labels consumed by the fleet verbs' --tag filter.
